name: DYNASTY Icon Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own top prize, carried by its only recorded champion into a return that was never confirmed to air.

name: DYNASTY North American Championship
epitaph: Billed as the promotion's own endurance title; no champion is ever attested in the surviving record.

name: DYNASTY Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Reserved for wrestlers 227 pounds and under; no champion is ever attested in the surviving record.

name: DYNASTY Icon Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Planned around an eight- or sixteen-team tournament that never reached a recorded result.
